label: Notch + Removable Shawl

profile.distinguishingDetail: The notch lapel with a removable shawl conversion extends the same dual-identity concept to the more relaxed notch lapel family, allowing a standard suit jacket to moonlight as a dinner jacket by attaching a shawl collar piece at the gorge. The result when the shawl is applied is a dinner jacket of conventional, smooth formality; when removed the jacket returns to everyday business suit territory. This construction is favoured by clients who attend formal occasions frequently enough to justify the engineering but not frequently enough to commission a dedicated tuxedo.
